authored_narrative.episode_purpose: The threshold and crossing motifs return a third time, now read through everything Episodes 1 and 2 earned — recognition and choice replacing disorientation and necessity.

scene_spirited_away_bathhouse_arrival_00.purpose: A second bathhouse-shaped space appears, but Gonagi and Dana no longer read it as a threshold to fear — the river-spirit thread from Episode 1 quietly resurfaces, this time recognized rather than endured.
scene_spirited_away_bathhouse_arrival_00.stakes: whether the growth from the first threshold actually held, now that a similar space asks the same question again
scene_spirited_away_bathhouse_arrival_00.opposing_force: the temptation to treat this second arrival as identical to the first, rather than as evidence of how far they've come

scene_spirited_away_bridge_crossing_0014.purpose: A second crossing, this one deliberate rather than desperate — Episode 2's isolation and labor both echo here, but chosen this time, not endured.
scene_spirited_away_bridge_crossing_0014.stakes: whether a crossing made freely carries the same weight as one made out of necessity
scene_spirited_away_bridge_crossing_0014.opposing_force: the industrial boiler-room setting's own echo of Episode 2's exhausting labor, threatening to make this feel like more of the same rather than a real return

shot_spirited_00097.intent: A framing that deliberately echoes shot 00001's wide establishing composition, but this time holds a beat longer — long enough to register recognition, not just scale.

shot_spirited_00105.intent: A steadier, more grounded framing than the original bridge crossing (shot 00009) — same exposure, but no longer treated as a precipice.
